title: Model full microfragment overhead and airtime
description:
Independently model bytes, RF airtime and scheduled block time including signatures, dispatch, fragment metadata, padding, preambles, LDRO, parity, acquisition, header recovery, response turns and guards. Model complete application-to-modem paths, not useful payload divided by a nominal bitrate.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Do not use the production airtime helper as oracle. This is a feasibility model, not RF evidence or permission to shorten authentication. Preserve baseline SCHC and security; physical measurements and experimental coding require their later gates.
acceptance_criteria: Semtech-formula anchors reproduce the 14-byte complete modem payload ceiling at SF10/BW125 in 300 ms and existing 62/70-byte framing costs. A 1280-byte IPv6 raw fallback starts at 1281 encoded bytes before experiment overhead. Separate scheduled duration, emitted airtime, occupancy and CPU work; expose infeasible parameter combinations.
